sql.if: and exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur inner join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id and r.status='0' where ur.user_id=#{currentUserId} and ( #{permissions} is null or #{permissions} = '' or exists ( select 1 from sys_role_menu rm inner join sys_menu m on m.menu_id=rm.menu_id where rm.role_id=r.role_id and m.status='0' and m.perms is not null and m.perms!='' and find_in_set(m.perms, #{permissions}) > 0 ) ) and ( r.data_scope='1' or (r.data_scope='2' and c.dept_id in (select dept_id from sys_role_dept where role_id=r.role_id)) or (r.data_scope='3' and c.dept_id=#{currentDeptId}) or (r.data_scope='4' and c.dept_id in (select sd.dept_id from sys_dept sd where sd.dept_id=#{currentDeptId} or find_in_set(#{currentDeptId}, sd.ancestors))) or (r.data_scope='5' and c.owner_id=#{currentUserId}) ) )

and exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur inner join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id and r.status='0' where ur.user_id=#{currentUserId} and ( #{permissions} is null or #{permissions} = '' or exists ( select 1 from sys_role_menu rm inner join sys_menu m on m.menu_id=rm.menu_id where rm.role_id=r.role_id and m.status='0' and m.perms is not null and m.perms!='' and find_in_set(m.perms, #{permissions}) > 0 ) ) and ( r.data_scope='1' or (r.data_scope='2' and c.dept_id in (select dept_id from sys_role_dept where role_id=r.role_id)) or (r.data_scope='3' and c.dept_id=#{currentDeptId}) or (r.data_scope='4' and c.dept_id in (select sd.dept_id from sys_dept sd where sd.dept_id=#{currentDeptId} or find_in_set(#{currentDeptId}, sd.ancestors))) or (r.data_scope='5' and (c.owner_id=#{currentUserId} or c.main_lawyer_id=#{currentUserId} or find_in_set(#{currentUserId}, ifnull(c.assistant_lawyer_ids,'')))) ) )

and exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur inner join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id and r.status='0' where ur.user_id=#{currentUserId} and ( r.data_scope='1' or (r.data_scope='2' and l.dept_id in (select rd.dept_id from sys_role_dept rd where rd.role_id=r.role_id)) or (r.data_scope='3' and l.dept_id=#{currentDeptId}) or (r.data_scope='4' and l.dept_id in (select sd.dept_id from sys_dept sd where sd.dept_id=#{currentDeptId} or find_in_set(#{currentDeptId}, sd.ancestors))) or (r.data_scope='5' and l.owner_id=#{currentUserId}) ) )

mapper.sql: p.plan_id planId, concat('YS', date_format(ifnull(p.create_time, sysdate()), '%Y%m%d'), lpad(p.plan_id, 4, '0')) receivableNo, p.contract_id contractId, c.contract_no contractNo, c.contract_name contractName, ca.case_id caseId, ca.case_no caseNo, ca.case_name caseName, c.customer_id customerId, c.customer_name customerName, c.case_type caseType, p.period_no periodNo, p.receivable_amount receivableAmount, ifnull(p.received_amount, 0) receivedAmount, greatest(p.receivable_amount - ifnull(p.received_amount, 0), 0) pendingAmount, p.plan_receive_date planReceiveDate, case when p.plan_receive_date is null then 0 else greatest(datediff(curdate(), p.plan_receive_date), 0) end agingDays, case when p.confirm_status='2' then 'rejected' when p.confirm_status='1' and ifnull(p.received_amount,0) >= p.receivable_amount then 'received' when p.confirm_status='1' and ifnull(p.received_amount,0) < p.receivable_amount then 'partial' when p.plan_receive_date is not null and p.plan_receive_date < curdate() then 'overdue' else 'pending' end receivableStatus, p.confirm_status confirmStatus, p.invoice_status invoiceStatus, p.payment_method paymentMethod, p.invoice_type invoiceType, c.owner_id ownerId, u.nick_name ownerName, c.risk_level riskLevel, p.remark, p.create_time createTime, p.update_time updateTime
mapper.select: select 'receivableTotal' metricKey, coalesce(sum(p.receivable_amount),0) metricValue from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0' union all select 'receivedTotal', coalesce(sum(case when p.confirm_status='1' then ifnull(p.received_amount,0) else 0 end),0) from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0' union all select 'pendingTotal', coalesce(sum(greatest(p.receivable_amount - ifnull(case when p.confirm_status='1' then p.received_amount else 0 end,0),0)),0) from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0' union all select 'overdueTotal', coalesce(sum(case when greatest(p.receivable_amount - ifnull(case when p.confirm_status='1' then p.received_amount else 0 end,0),0) > 0 and p.plan_receive_date < curdate() then greatest(p.receivable_amount - ifnull(case when p.confirm_status='1' then p.received_amount else 0 end,0),0) else 0 end),0) from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0' union all select 'monthReceived', coalesce(sum(case when p.confirm_status='1' and date_format(p.update_time,'%Y%m')=date_format(sysdate(),'%Y%m') then ifnull(p.received_amount,0) else 0 end),0) from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0' union all select 'pendingInvoiceTotal', coalesce(sum(case when p.confirm_status='1' and p.invoice_status in ('0','2') then ifnull(p.received_amount,0) else 0 end),0) from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0' union all select 'invoicedTotal', coalesce(sum(case when p.confirm_status='1' and p.invoice_status='1' then ifnull(p.received_amount,0) else 0 end),0) from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0' union all select 'monthExpense', coalesce(sum(case when date_format(e.occur_date,'%Y%m')=date_format(sysdate(),'%Y%m') then ifnull(e.amount,0) else 0 end),0) from biz_case_expense e left join biz_case c on c.case_id=e.case_id where e.del_flag='0' and c.del_flag='0' union all select 'pendingPaymentAmount', coalesce(sum(case when p.confirm_status='0' then ifnull(p.receivable_amount,0) else 0 end),0) from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0'

select date_format(p.update_time, '%Y-%m') itemName, coalesce(sum(ifnull(p.received_amount,0)),0) itemValue, count(*) itemCount from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0' and p.confirm_status='1'
and p.update_time >= #{beginDate}
and p.update_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 6 month)
and p.update_time < date_add(#{endDate}, interval 1 day)
group by date_format(p.update_time, '%Y-%m') order by itemName asc

select bucket itemName, count(*) itemValue, coalesce(sum(pendingAmount),0) amountValue from ( select case when p.plan_receive_date is null or datediff(curdate(), p.plan_receive_date) <= 0 then 'current' when datediff(curdate(), p.plan_receive_date) <= 30 then 'd30' when datediff(curdate(), p.plan_receive_date) <= 60 then 'd60' when datediff(curdate(), p.plan_receive_date) <= 90 then 'd90' else 'd90plus' end bucket, greatest(p.receivable_amount - ifnull(p.received_amount,0),0) pendingAmount from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0' and greatest(p.receivable_amount - ifnull(case when p.confirm_status='1' then p.received_amount else 0 end,0),0) > 0
) t group by bucket

select 'contracts' metricKey, count(distinct c.contract_id) metricValue, coalesce(sum(c.sign_amount),0) amountValue from biz_contract c where c.del_flag='0' union all select 'matters', count(distinct ca.case_id), coalesce(sum(ifnull(c.sign_amount,0)),0) from biz_contract c left join biz_case ca on ca.contract_id=c.contract_id and ca.del_flag='0' where c.del_flag='0' union all select 'expenses', count(distinct e.expense_id), coalesce(sum(e.amount),0) from biz_case_expense e left join biz_case c on c.case_id=e.case_id where e.del_flag='0' and c.del_flag='0'

select 'overdueReceivable' metricKey, count(*) metricValue, coalesce(sum(greatest(p.receivable_amount - ifnull(case when p.confirm_status='1' then p.received_amount else 0 end,0),0)),0) amountValue from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0' and greatest(p.receivable_amount - ifnull(case when p.confirm_status='1' then p.received_amount else 0 end,0),0) > 0 and p.plan_receive_date < curdate()
union all select 'pendingInvoice', count(*), coalesce(sum(ifnull(p.received_amount,0)),0) from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0' and p.confirm_status='1' and p.invoice_status in ('0','2')
union all select 'highRisk', count(*), coalesce(sum(greatest(p.receivable_amount - ifnull(case when p.confirm_status='1' then p.received_amount else 0 end,0),0)),0) from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0' and c.risk_level='3' and greatest(p.receivable_amount - ifnull(case when p.confirm_status='1' then p.received_amount else 0 end,0),0) > 0

select 'contractAmount' metricKey, coalesce(sum(ifnull(c.sign_amount,0)),0) metricValue from biz_contract c where c.del_flag='0' union all select 'receivablePlan', coalesce(sum(ifnull(p.receivable_amount,0)),0) from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0' union all select 'receivedAmount', coalesce(sum(case when p.confirm_status='1' then ifnull(p.received_amount,0) else 0 end),0) from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0' union all select 'invoicedAmount', coalesce(sum(case when p.confirm_status='1' and p.invoice_status='1' then ifnull(p.received_amount,0) else 0 end),0) from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0' union all select 'expenseAmount', coalesce(sum(ifnull(e.amount,0)),0) from biz_case_expense e left join biz_case c on c.case_id=e.case_id where e.del_flag='0' and c.del_flag='0' union all select 'netIncome', coalesce(( select sum(case when p.confirm_status='1' then ifnull(p.received_amount,0) else 0 end) from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0' ),0) - coalesce(( select sum(ifnull(e.amount,0)) from biz_case_expense e left join biz_case c on c.case_id=e.case_id where e.del_flag='0' and c.del_flag='0' ),0)

select itemName, coalesce(sum(invoiceAmount),0) invoiceAmount, coalesce(sum(expenseAmount),0) expenseAmount from ( select date_format(p.update_time, '%Y-%m') itemName, coalesce(sum(case when p.confirm_status='1' and p.invoice_status='1' then ifnull(p.received_amount,0) else 0 end),0) invoiceAmount, 0 expenseAmount from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0' and p.update_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 6 month)
group by date_format(p.update_time, '%Y-%m') union all select date_format(e.occur_date, '%Y-%m') itemName, 0 invoiceAmount, coalesce(sum(ifnull(e.amount,0)),0) expenseAmount from biz_case_expense e left join biz_case c on c.case_id=e.case_id where e.del_flag='0' and c.del_flag='0' and e.occur_date >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 6 month)
group by date_format(e.occur_date, '%Y-%m') ) t where itemName is not null group by itemName order by itemName asc

select concat('KP', date_format(ifnull(p.update_time, p.create_time), '%Y%m%d'), lpad(p.plan_id, 4, '0')) invoiceApplyNo, case when p.invoice_status='1' then concat('FP', date_format(p.update_time, '%Y%m%d'), lpad(p.plan_id, 4, '0')) else null end invoiceNo, c.customer_name customerName, c.contract_no contractNo, ifnull(p.received_amount, p.receivable_amount) amount, p.update_time invoiceDate, p.invoice_status invoiceStatus, p.invoice_type invoiceType from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0' and p.confirm_status='1' and p.invoice_status in ('1','2')
order by p.update_time desc, p.plan_id desc limit #{dashboardLimit}

select 'expense' metricKey, '费用支出' itemName, coalesce(sum(case when date_format(e.occur_date,'%Y%m')=date_format(sysdate(),'%Y%m') then ifnull(e.amount,0) else 0 end),0) monthValue, coalesce(sum(case when date_format(e.occur_date,'%Y')=date_format(sysdate(),'%Y') then ifnull(e.amount,0) else 0 end),0) yearValue from biz_case_expense e left join biz_case c on c.case_id=e.case_id where e.del_flag='0' and c.del_flag='0' union all select 'received', '回款金额', coalesce(sum(case when p.confirm_status='1' and date_format(p.update_time,'%Y%m')=date_format(sysdate(),'%Y%m') then ifnull(p.received_amount,0) else 0 end),0), coalesce(sum(case when p.confirm_status='1' and date_format(p.update_time,'%Y')=date_format(sysdate(),'%Y') then ifnull(p.received_amount,0) else 0 end),0) from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0' union all select 'netIncome', '净收入', coalesce(( select sum(case when p.confirm_status='1' and date_format(p.update_time,'%Y%m')=date_format(sysdate(),'%Y%m') then ifnull(p.received_amount,0) else 0 end) from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0' ),0) - coalesce(( select sum(case when date_format(e.occur_date,'%Y%m')=date_format(sysdate(),'%Y%m') then ifnull(e.amount,0) else 0 end) from biz_case_expense e left join biz_case c on c.case_id=e.case_id where e.del_flag='0' and c.del_flag='0' ),0), coalesce(( select sum(case when p.confirm_status='1' and date_format(p.update_time,'%Y')=date_format(sysdate(),'%Y') then ifnull(p.received_amount,0) else 0 end) from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0' ),0) - coalesce(( select sum(case when date_format(e.occur_date,'%Y')=date_format(sysdate(),'%Y') then ifnull(e.amount,0) else 0 end) from biz_case_expense e left join biz_case c on c.case_id=e.case_id where e.del_flag='0' and c.del_flag='0' ),0) union all select 'receiveCount', '回款笔数', count(case when p.confirm_status='1' and date_format(p.update_time,'%Y%m')=date_format(sysdate(),'%Y%m') then 1 end), count(case when p.confirm_status='1' and date_format(p.update_time,'%Y')=date_format(sysdate(),'%Y') then 1 end) from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0'

select coalesce(s.setting_name, l.source_code, '未设置') itemName, count(*) leadCount, sum(case when l.status='3' then 1 else 0 end) convertedCount, round(sum(case when l.status='3' then 1 else 0 end) * 100 / nullif(count(*),0), 2) conversionRate, coalesce(sum(if(l.status='3', ifnull(l.estimated_amount,0), 0)),0) estimatedAmount from biz_lead l left join biz_lead_setting s on s.setting_type='source' and s.setting_code=l.source_code and s.status='0' where l.del_flag='0' and l.create_time >= #{beginDate} and l.create_time < date_add(#{endDate}, interval 1 day)
group by coalesce(s.setting_name, l.source_code, '未设置') order by convertedCount desc, leadCount desc limit 8

select from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id left join biz_case ca on ca.contract_id=c.contract_id and ca.del_flag='0' left join sys_user u on u.user_id=c.owner_id
and c.del_flag='0' and (c.contract_no like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or ca.case_no like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or c.customer_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%')) and c.contract_no like concat('%',#{contractNo},'%') and ca.case_no like concat('%',#{caseNo},'%') and c.customer_name like concat('%',#{customerName},'%') and p.confirm_status=#{confirmStatus} and p.invoice_status=#{invoiceStatus} and c.owner_id=#{ownerId} and c.risk_level=#{riskLevel} and p.plan_receive_date >= #{beginDate} and p.plan_receive_date <= #{endDate} and greatest(p.receivable_amount - ifnull(case when p.confirm_status='1' then p.received_amount else 0 end,0),0) > 0 and greatest(p.receivable_amount - ifnull(case when p.confirm_status='1' then p.received_amount else 0 end,0),0) > 0 and p.plan_receive_date < curdate()
and (p.plan_receive_date is null or datediff(curdate(), p.plan_receive_date) <= 0) and datediff(curdate(), p.plan_receive_date) between 1 and 30 and datediff(curdate(), p.plan_receive_date) between 31 and 60 and datediff(curdate(), p.plan_receive_date) between 61 and 90 and datediff(curdate(), p.plan_receive_date) > 90
order by p.plan_receive_date asc, p.plan_id desc limit #{dashboardLimit}

select , concat('KP', date_format(ifnull(p.update_time, p.create_time), '%Y%m%d'), lpad(p.plan_id, 4, '0')) invoiceApplyNo, case when p.invoice_status='1' then concat('FP', date_format(p.update_time, '%Y%m%d'), lpad(p.plan_id, 4, '0')) else null end invoiceNo from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id left join biz_case ca on ca.contract_id=c.contract_id and ca.del_flag='0' left join sys_user u on u.user_id=c.owner_id
and c.del_flag='0' and (c.contract_no like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or ca.case_no like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or c.customer_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%')) and p.confirm_status=#{confirmStatus} and p.invoice_status=#{invoiceStatus} and p.confirm_status='1' and p.invoice_status in ('0','2') and coalesce(p.update_time, p.plan_receive_date, p.create_time) >= #{beginDate} and coalesce(p.update_time, p.plan_receive_date, p.create_time) < date_add(#{endDate}, interval 1 day)
order by p.update_time desc, p.plan_id desc

select e.*, c.case_id caseId, c.case_no caseNo, c.case_name caseName, c.customer_name customerName, c.case_status caseStatus, c.contract_no contractNo from biz_case_expense e left join biz_case c on c.case_id=e.case_id
and e.del_flag='0' and c.del_flag='0' and e.expense_id=#{expenseId}
mapper.update: update biz_case_expense set expense_type=#{expenseType}, amount=#{amount}, occur_date=#{occurDate}, pay_status=#{payStatus}, reimburse_status=#{reimburseStatus}, voucher_status=#{voucherStatus}, handler_id=#{handlerId}, handler_name=#{handlerName}, voucher_url=#{voucherUrl}, voucher_name=#{voucherName}, remark=#{remark}, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=sysdate() where expense_id=#{expenseId} and del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select c.case_id caseId, c.case_no caseNo, c.case_name caseName, c.customer_name customerName, c.case_type caseType, c.case_status caseStatus, c.main_lawyer_name mainLawyerName, c.assistant_lawyer_names assistantLawyerNames, c.contract_id contractId, c.contract_no contractNo, ct.contract_name contractName, ct.sign_amount contractAmount, ct.sign_status signStatus, ct.contract_status contractStatus, ifnull(fp.receivableTotal,0) receivableTotal, ifnull(fp.receivedTotal,0) receivedTotal, ifnull(fp.pendingTotal,0) pendingTotal, ifnull(fp.overdueTotal,0) overdueTotal, ifnull(ex.expenseTotal,0) expenseTotal, ifnull(ex.paidExpenseTotal,0) paidExpenseTotal, ifnull(ex.unpaidExpenseTotal,0) unpaidExpenseTotal, ifnull(ex.voucherMissingCount,0) voucherMissingCount, ifnull(fp.receivedTotal,0) - ifnull(ex.expenseTotal,0) grossProfit, case when ifnull(fp.receivedTotal,0) = 0 then 0 else round((ifnull(fp.receivedTotal,0) - ifnull(ex.expenseTotal,0)) * 100 / ifnull(fp.receivedTotal,0), 2) end grossMargin from biz_case c left join biz_contract ct on ct.contract_id=c.contract_id and ct.del_flag='0' left join ( select p.contract_id, coalesce(sum(p.receivable_amount),0) receivableTotal, coalesce(sum(case when p.confirm_status='1' then ifnull(p.received_amount,0) else 0 end),0) receivedTotal, coalesce(sum(greatest(p.receivable_amount - ifnull(case when p.confirm_status='1' then p.received_amount else 0 end,0),0)),0) pendingTotal, coalesce(sum(case when greatest(p.receivable_amount - ifnull(case when p.confirm_status='1' then p.received_amount else 0 end,0),0) > 0 and p.plan_receive_date < curdate() then greatest(p.receivable_amount - ifnull(case when p.confirm_status='1' then p.received_amount else 0 end,0),0) else 0 end),0) overdueTotal from biz_contract_fee_plan p group by p.contract_id ) fp on fp.contract_id=ct.contract_id left join ( select e.case_id, coalesce(sum(e.amount),0) expenseTotal, coalesce(sum(case when e.pay_status='paid' then e.amount else 0 end),0) paidExpenseTotal, coalesce(sum(case when ifnull(e.pay_status,'pending')!='paid' then e.amount else 0 end),0) unpaidExpenseTotal, sum(case when ifnull(e.voucher_status,'missing')!='uploaded' then 1 else 0 end) voucherMissingCount from biz_case_expense e where e.del_flag='0' group by e.case_id ) ex on ex.case_id=c.case_id where c.del_flag='0' and c.case_id=#{caseId}

select p.plan_id planId, p.period_no periodNo, p.receivable_amount receivableAmount, ifnull(p.received_amount,0) receivedAmount, greatest(p.receivable_amount - ifnull(p.received_amount,0),0) pendingAmount, p.plan_receive_date planReceiveDate, p.confirm_status confirmStatus, p.invoice_status invoiceStatus, p.payment_method paymentMethod, p.invoice_type invoiceType, p.finance_user_id financeUserId, p.remark, p.create_time createTime, p.update_time updateTime from biz_case c inner join biz_contract_fee_plan p on p.contract_id=c.contract_id where c.del_flag='0' and c.case_id=#{caseId}
order by p.period_no, p.plan_id

select e.expense_id expenseId, e.expense_no expenseNo, e.case_id caseId, e.expense_type expenseType, e.amount, e.occur_date occurDate, e.pay_status payStatus, e.reimburse_status reimburseStatus, e.voucher_status voucherStatus, e.handler_name handlerName, e.voucher_url voucherUrl, e.voucher_name voucherName, e.remark, e.create_time createTime, e.update_time updateTime from biz_case c inner join biz_case_expense e on e.case_id=c.case_id and e.del_flag='0' where c.del_flag='0' and c.case_id=#{caseId}
order by e.occur_date desc, e.expense_id desc

select ifnull(c.lawyer_name, '未指定') itemName, coalesce(sum(case when p.confirm_status='1' then p.received_amount else 0 end),0) itemValue from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0' and p.update_time >= #{beginDate} and p.update_time < date_add(#{endDate}, interval 1 day)
group by ifnull(c.lawyer_name, '未指定') order by itemValue desc limit 8

select ifnull(c.case_type, 'unknown') itemName, coalesce(sum(e.amount),0) itemValue from biz_case_expense e left join biz_case c on c.case_id=e.case_id where e.del_flag='0' and c.del_flag='0' and e.occur_date >= #{beginDate} and e.occur_date <= #{endDate}
group by ifnull(c.case_type, 'unknown') order by itemValue desc limit 8

select ifnull(u.nick_name, '未指定') itemName, coalesce(sum(case when p.confirm_status='1' then p.received_amount else 0 end),0) itemValue from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id=c.owner_id where c.del_flag='0' and p.update_time >= #{beginDate} and p.update_time < date_add(#{endDate}, interval 1 day)
group by ifnull(u.nick_name, '未指定') order by itemValue desc limit 8
